descrip: Enacts the safe access to care act
summary: Enacts the safe access to care act requiring certain healthcare facilities to adopt and make public a statement of patient rights and healthcare facility obligations with regards to immigration enforcement; includes unlawful or non-judicially authorized immigration enforcement actions at a healthcare facility as a workplace threat or hazard for purposes of the violence prevention program.

descrip: Permits certain members of the state liquor authority or officers, deputies, assistants, inspectors or employees thereof to be a member of a community board of education
summary: Permits certain members of the state liquor authority or officers, deputies, assistants, inspectors or employees thereof to be a member of a board of education.

descrip: Grants certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites
summary: Enacts the heroes park pass act to grant certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites.

descrip: Creates shared housing rooming units in new class A multiple dwellings or buildings converted to class A multiple dwellings
summary: Creates shared housing rooming units in new class A multiple dwellings or buildings converted to class A multiple dwellings; creates new regulations in the New York city building codes.

descrip: Relates to the commencement of certain sexual offense actions
summary: Relates to the commencement of certain sexual offense actions; extends the time for such commencement to two years and six months after the effective date of the section of law allowing such actions.

descrip: Prohibits city agencies from procuring single-use water containers
summary: Prohibits city agencies of the city of New York from procuring single-use water containers.

descrip: Relates to affordable housing in New York city
summary: Provides that no tax exemption shall be given for any unit that has not agreed in writing to maintain such unit as their primary residence for no less than five years from the acquisition of such unit.

descrip: Authorizes single stairway residential buildings in a city having a population of one million of more
summary: Directs the state fire prevention and building code council to develop standards permitting single stairway residential buildings up to six stories or seventy-five feet in height in a city having a population of one million or more.

descrip: Establishes access to postsecondary educational programming and creating an educational transfer process for incarcerated individuals
summary: Expands access to higher education in correctional facilities by requiring the department of corrections and community supervision to provide meaningful access to postsecondary educational programming and to establish a transparent process for incarcerated individuals to request transfers to facilities where such programs are available.

descrip: Establishes the build more, get more incentive fund
summary: Establishes the build more, get more incentive fund to provide incentive payments to municipalities based on the number of eligible new housing units produced within such municipality.

descrip: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish the results of annual audits of approved applications for temporary major capital improvement increases on its website annually
summary: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish the results of annual audits of approved applications for temporary major capital improvement increases on its website annually.

descrip: Relates to requiring the use of a water demand calculator in new construction and substantial renovations and establishing an advisory board to monitor such usage
summary: Provides that the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code shall address standards requiring the use of a water demand calculator to determine pipe and fixture sizing for use in new construction and substantial renovations of single-family and multi-unit residential buildings; directs the chairperson of the state fire prevention and building code council to appoint an advisory board to monitor the use of water demand calculators in new construction and substantial renovations and to monitor and keep records of cost savings resulting from the use of such water demand calculators.

descrip: Provides enhanced building aid for school construction projects in municipalities that meet transit-oriented development or housing growth benchmarks
summary: Provides that for any school district located wholly or partially within a municipality that meets transit-oriented development or housing growth benchmarks, the approved building aid ratio for any eligible capital construction project shall be increased by five percentage points.

descrip: Exempts from the payment of sales tax charges for haircuts and basic barbering and cosmetology services

descrip: Expands the state rental registry identifying lead hazards to include all residential dwellings meeting certain conditions

descrip: Establishes the crime of aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle resulting in death

descrip: Authorizes payments to nonparticipating or nonpreferred providers of medical services

descrip: Relates to disclosing certain diagnostic results to patients on their electronic health record

descrip: Prohibits harmful and adulterated kratom products

descrip: Enacts the "wireless security enforcement act"

summary: Exempts certain property within Manhattan in the city of New York from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a school or place of worship.

summary: Prohibits the use of timeout boxes, closets or other secluded physical enclosures for children in schools in the state except for authorized uses prescribed by the commissioner.

summary: Provides that services provided to persons qualifying for nursing home diversion and transition services shall not be provided to medical assistance recipients through managed care programs.

descrip: Relates to the placement of children in the care of a non-respondent parent during the pendency of a child protective proceeding
summary: Provides that the retention of the child in the home of a non-respondent parent with whom the child resided prior to the filing of the proceeding under this article shall not constitute a release or placement; requires that where, during the pendency of a proceeding under this article, a child either remains in the home of a non-respondent parent or parents or is released to a non-respondent parent or parents, the court may require the cooperation of such non-respondent parent or parents to the extent necessary to meet the needs of the child with respect to the proceeding, including, but not limited to, a direction to make the child available for court-ordered visitation with respondents, siblings and others, as well as appointments with the child's attorney, clinician or other individual or program providing services to the child during the pendency of the proceeding.

summary: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail to advise voters that such ballot should be returned to the board of elections as soon as possible by any approved method, and further recommend the use of alternative methods of return besides domestic mail services if the voter will be returning their ballot within several days of the election.

summary: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parkland in the town of Windham, located in the county of Greene, for the purposes of decommissioning an old baseball facility and pedestrian safety.

summary: Extends the deadline for reduction in class size under contracts for excellence in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants.

summary: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school.

summary: Relates to permitting the Westchester Muslim Center, Inc. to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

summary: Relates to permitting the Immanuel Evangelical Lutheran Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

summary: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2026 assessment roll.

summary: Relates to construction and mentoring programs; provides that any agency may establish a mentoring program for small businesses that perform construction or architectural or engineering services related to construction.

descrip: Relates to judicial districts

summary: Provides for instances in which a person or entity in the state of New York shall comply with or provide information in response to an inquiry, investigation, subpoena, or summons related to procedures for protections of legally protected health activities; adds that such disclosure requirements shall not apply to the disclosure of deidentified information in compliance with state grant reporting requirements or other reporting requirements under state law.

descrip: Relates to the staffing and operations of a cancer research institute and a related not-for-profit corporation
summary: Transfers the Buffalo Division of Health Research, Inc. to the Roswell Park Cancer Research Corporation.

descrip: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; appropriation
summary: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; authorizes funding of joint labor-management committees; implements agreements between the state and an employee organization; makes an appropriation therefor (Part A); provides for the salaries of certain state officers and employees excluded from collective negotiating units; makes an appropriation therefor (Part B).

descrip: Relates to other post-employment benefits reserve funds for counties, cities, villages and towns
summary: Authorizes the governing board of any county, city, village or town to establish one or more other post-employment benefits reserve funds for the financing of all or part of the cost of providing other post-employment benefits to eligible retired employees and their dependents.

descrip: Relates to energy efficiency and weatherization
summary: Directs NYSERDA to issue a request for proposals to identify cities, towns, or villages that are interested in participating in municipal-level energy efficiency and weatherization pilot projects to help decrease residential energy usage and reduce future capital costs for utilities; directs NYSERDA to identify three pilot areas focusing on the ability to replicate projects elsewhere and the costs and benefits to ratepayers both in the affected area and in the rest of the utility service territory.

summary: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes where the victim is under the influence of any drug, intoxicant, or other substance to a degree which rendered the victim temporarily incapable of appraising or controlling such person's conduct and such condition was known or reasonably should have been known to a person in the actor's situation.

descrip: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

descrip: Permits the city of Yonkers to establish a surcharge for vacant and abandoned property
summary: Permits the city of Yonkers to establish a surcharge for up to 3 times the standard tax rate for vacant and abandoned property.

summary: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

descrip: Relates to increasing certain special accidental death benefits paid to widows and orphaned children of members
summary: Increases certain special accidental death benefits paid to a widow or widower or the children of a deceased member of the state and local retirement system.

descrip: Updates provisions relating to the independent redistricting commission
summary: Updates provisions relating to the independent redistricting commission; provides for redistricting following every federal census.

descrip: Enacts the washing our clothes without polluting our water act
summary: Makes provisions for washing machine microfiber filtration to reduce water pollution.

descrip: Relates to the form of submission and abstract for proposed amendments to the constitution
summary: Authorizes the form of submission and abstract for proposed amendments to the constitution submitted to the people to be determined by enactment in a separate joint resolution passed by both houses of the legislature at least 120 days prior to the general election where such amendment to the constitution shall be submitted.

descrip: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to tickets to places of entertainment
summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to tickets to places of entertainment.

descrip: Relates to the ability of the New York state medical care facilities finance agency to issue certain bonds and notes
summary: Increases the authorization of the Dormitory Authority of the State of New York ("DASNY"), as successor to the New York State Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency ("MCFFA") pursuant to the Health Care Financing Consolidation Act of 1995, to issue hospital and nursing home project bonds and notes from $20 billion to $21.8 billion.

descrip: Enacts the responsible data center development act
summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

descrip: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board; repealer
summary: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board.

descrip: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
summary: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section 11-3206 of the administrative code of the city of New York (Part E); provides for the temporary transfer of racing support payments (Part F).

descrip: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Albertson
summary: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Albertson; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; relates to the management and control as well as the usage of moneys received from foreign fire insurance companies by such association.

descrip: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
summary: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Schoharie.

descrip: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Efrain Barreto
summary: Dedicates a portion of state route 278, between 4th Avenue and 7th Avenue in Brooklyn, to Efrain Barreto.

descrip: Implements an agreement between the state and an employee organization; providing for the adjustment of salaries of certain incumbents in the professional service in the state university; appropriation
summary: Implements an agreement between the state and an employee organization; provides for the adjustment of salaries of certain incumbents in the professional service in the state university; makes an appropriation for the purpose of effectuating certain provisions thereof.

descrip: Provides that immediate injunctive relief, restraining orders, or cease and desist orders may be sought in cases where voter intimidation, deception or obstruction occurs
summary: Provides that immediate injunctive relief, restraining orders, or cease and desist orders may be sought in certain cases involving voter intimidation, deception or obstruction that affects the right of voters to access the elective franchise.

descrip: Extends the expansion of eligibility for World Trade Center death and disability benefits for members of New York's organized militia
summary: Extends the expansion of eligibility for World Trade Center death and disability benefits for members of New York's organized militia for an additional four years.

descrip: Relates to criminal possession of stolen property in the third, second and first degrees
summary: Redefines criminal possession of stolen property in the third, second and first degrees to include possession of certain residential real property, commercial property and mixed-use property.

descrip: Enacts the "mansion tax adjustment act"
summary: Enacts the "mansion tax adjustment act"; increases the sales price threshold for real property conveyances that will trigger additional sales tax.

descrip: Authorizes the Chabad of Sea Gate to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
summary: Authorizes the Chabad of Sea Gate to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

descrip: Relates to controlling and abusive litigation
summary: Establishes penalties where a party is found to be engaged in controlling and abusive litigation against another where they have committed an act of domestic violence against the other party and in bad faith such person advances or continues litigation against the party who is the victim of the domestic violence.

descrip: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; repealer
summary: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; implements the agreements between the state and the public employees federation.

descrip: Grants the gaming commission the authority to develop, and require racetrack operators to implement, fire protection systems requirements for stables and barns
summary: Grants the gaming commission the authority to develop, and require racetrack operators to implement, fire protection systems requirements for stables and barns used to house horses at racetracks.

descrip: Prohibits persons in certain relationships to members of the legislature from engaging in certain activities that are deemed an indirect interest of a legislator
summary: Prohibits spouses, domestic or romantic partners, persons residing in the same household, or immediate family members of members of the legislature from engaging in certain activities that are deemed an indirect interest of a legislator; defines indirect interest; provides an opportunity to cure a violation of such provisions.

descrip: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools and establishing the board of regents as the primary charter vetting and oversight authority
summary: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools and establishing the board of regents as the primary charter vetting and oversight authority; provides that charter school applicants shall first apply to the community district education council or the board of education of the school district for approval for renewal of a charter within a certain amount of time and public hearings shall be conducted on such proposed application; provides that school district funding shall be contingent on application certification by the community district education council or the voters of the school district.

descrip: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Chief Hugh (Chaim) Jacobson
summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Ramapo, county of Rockland, to Chief Hugh (Chaim) Jacobson.

descrip: Relates to adaptive aquatic safety services for individuals with disabilities
summary: Relates to adaptive aquatic safety services for individuals with disabilities; directs the commissioner of health to evaluate and seek approval for the inclusion of adaptive aquatic safety services as an available service component under applicable Medicaid home and community-based services authorities; relates to adaptive aquatic accessibility at state-funded public aquatic facilities; directs the commissioner of health to promulgate regulations requiring lifeguard certification and recertification courses to include instruction concerning aquatic safety for individuals with disabilities; authorizes school districts and boards of cooperative educational services to incorporate adaptive aquatic safety goals into individualized education programs where appropriate to address certain skills.

descrip: Restores conformity with certain provisions of the Internal Revenue Code relating to business expensing; repealer
summary: Restores conformity with certain provisions of the Internal Revenue Code relating to business expensing.

descrip: Relates to conflicts of interest of boards of elections employees and election commissioners
summary: Prohibits a board of elections employee or election commissioner from being employed by or controlling any political action committee that is organized for the purpose of any election administered by the board at which such employee is employed or which such commissioner oversees.

descrip: Relates to reporting of certain independent expenditures
summary: Relates to reporting of certain independent expenditures and penalties for failing to report such expenditures; includes certain communications which use language or imagery substantially associated with a candidate's campaign, platform, background, or publicly stated positions, such that a reasonable viewer would understand the communication as designed to influence the outcome of such general, special, or primary election in the definition of independent expenditure.

descrip: Relates to establishing a purple alert program to assist in the location and safe recovery of missing vulnerable persons
summary: Directs the division of state police to establish and administer a purple alert program to assist in the location and safe recovery of missing vulnerable persons.

descrip: Enacts the "Social Worker Initiative for Faster Testing (SWIFT) act"
summary: Enacts the "Social Worker Initiative for Faster Testing (SWIFT) act"; provides that with respect to the examination requirement for licensure as a master social worker, an applicant pursuing a master's of social work degree who is enrolled in the final semester of a program registered by the department of education or an educational program accredited or in candidacy for accreditation by the council on social work education shall be eligible to take the master's level examination.

descrip: Designates the Nature Center at Rockland Lake State Park as the "Lauren Shields Nature Center"
summary: Designates the Nature Center at Rockland Lake State Park as the "Lauren Shields Nature Center".

descrip: Establishes a presumption that certain refunds received by public utility companies shall be passed on to ratepayers
summary: Establishes a presumption that certain refunds received by public utility companies shall be passed on to ratepayers through bill credits, direct refunds, reductions in future rates, or other methods that provide a direct and equitable benefit to affected ratepayers.

descrip: Establishes the indigenous clean biofuel innovation and resource partnership pilot program to develop and deploy low-carbon bio-blended fuels in alignment with the state's clean fuel standards; appropriation
summary: Establishes the indigenous clean biofuel innovation and resource partnership pilot program to develop and deploy low-carbon bio-blended fuels in alignment with the state's clean fuel standards.

descrip: Establishes the indigenous black carbon recovery and clean energy manufacturing pilot program in the capital district and adjoining regions; appropriation
summary: Establishes the indigenous black carbon recovery and clean energy manufacturing pilot program in the capital district and adjoining regions.

descrip: Relates to humanoid robots and artificial intelligence avatars in instructional settings
summary: Provides that each school district, charter school, and board of cooperative educational services shall adopt and implement a written policy governing the use of humanoid robots in schools and that such policy shall prohibit the use of an artificial intelligence-enabled humanoid robot in an instructional capacity; defines terms.

descrip: Relates to disposal of radioactive waste
summary: Provides that all waste containing source, byproduct, or special nuclear material shall be hazardous waste.

descrip: Enacts the Public Health Modernization Act
summary: Directs the department to repeal subpart 24-2 of part 24 of title 10 of the New York Codes, Rules and Regulations in its entirety and promulgate new rules and regulations governing the licensing and operation of certain commercial establishments.

descrip: Establishes the home kitchen enterprise and economic opportunity act
summary: Establishes the home kitchen enterprise and economic opportunity act; relates to the licensing and operation of home kitchen operations which store, handle, prepare and package ready-to-eat food for consumers.

descrip: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating certain licensed professionals
summary: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating certain licensed professionals.

descrip: Prohibits operators of a website, application, software, program, or service from allowing users to nudify a still or video image
summary: Prohibits operators of a website, application, software, program, or service from allowing users to nudify a still or video image; prohibits advertising or promoting websites, applications, software, programs, or services that allow users to nudify a still or video image; provides an exception when technical skill is required to nudify an image; establishes penalties for violations of such provisions; establishes the nudification prohibition recoveries services fund to provide grants to support the direct needs of victims of sexual assault, domestic violence, and child abuse.

descrip: Directs the office of the state comptroller to conduct a study on establishing a universal pension system
summary: Directs the office of the state comptroller to conduct a study on establishing a universal pension system in the state of New York; requires the office of the state comptroller to submit a report of such study.

descrip: Establishes the literary lifecycle management or LLM act which prohibits the destruction of rare books
summary: Establishes the literary lifecycle management or LLM act which prohibits the destruction of rare books; imposes civil penalties.

descrip: Includes certain violations involving children as qualifying offenses for the purpose of imposing bail
summary: Includes certain violations involving physical, psychological, or emotional harm to a child as qualifying offenses for the purpose of imposing bail.

descrip: Relates to the handling of tips received through the office of the Medicaid inspector general's Medicaid fraud hotline
summary: Relates to the handling of tips received through the office of the Medicaid inspector general's Medicaid fraud hotline; provides that the office of the Medicaid inspector general's Medicaid fraud hotline shall be the official Medicaid fraud hotline of the state of New York; directs the Medicaid inspector general to compile and provide to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the minority leader of the senate, the minority leader of the assembly and the attorney general an annual report containing information on tips received through the Medicaid fraud hotline.

descrip: Establishes a Medicaid fraud tip board and Medicaid fraud tip reward fund
summary: Establishes a Medicaid fraud tip board which shall develop and administer a system offering monetary rewards to certain individuals reporting Medicaid fraud; creates a Medicaid fraud tip reward fund.

descrip: Establishes multidisciplinary personnel teams
summary: Establishes multidisciplinary personnel teams to ensure prompt, coordinated, and confidential sharing of information among professionals for effective identification, assessment, and delivery of housing and supportive services.

descrip: Relates to recognizing postpartum psychosis as a condition distinct from postpartum depression and directing the department of health to create screening guidelines for the condition
summary: Relates to recognizing postpartum psychosis as a condition distinct from postpartum depression and directing the department of health to create screening guidelines for the condition and provide information to maternal health care providers.

descrip: Relates to the timeframe for the signature of attesting witnesses to a will
summary: Provides that a testator need not be alive at the time of the attesting witnesses signatures as long as the signature is within the thirty day timeframe.

descrip: Enacts the "Fostering Optimal Classroom Use of Screens (FOCUS) act" to limit use of internet enabled devices and prioritize non-digital teaching methods
summary: Enacts the "fostering optimal classroom use of screens (FOCUS) act" to limit use of internet enabled and electronic devices and prioritize non-digital teaching methods; prohibits use by younger students; limits and restricts certain uses by older students; requires written policies for opting in for the school issued devices; prohibits social media applications, gaming and AI in school issued devices; requires registration by educational technology providers.

descrip: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance resulting in death
summary: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance resulting in death, a class A-1 felony.

descrip: Relates to notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases
summary: Requires notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases to include a statement on the first page explaining in plain language the tenant's right to answer or reply and how a tenant may request an extension of time to submit such answer or reply.

descrip: Opts the state out of certain provisions of the Depository Institutions Deregulation and Monetary Control Act of 1980, Public Law 96-221
summary: Opts the state out of certain provisions of the Depository Institutions Deregulation and Monetary Control Act of 1980, Public Law 96-221; establishes applicable interest limitations.

descrip: Establishes the volunteer and municipal ambulance services grant program
summary: Establishes the volunteer and municipal ambulance services grant program to support projects which sustain or enhance the operation of volunteer and municipal ambulance services, including but not limited to acquisition or maintenance of buildings, equipment, technology, or vehicles.

descrip: Establishes September twenty-fifth of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "9 to 5 Day"
summary: Establishes September twenty-fifth of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "9 to 5 Day" in honor of Dolly Parton.

descrip: Enacts "Jacob Freytes' law"
summary: Enacts "Jacob Freytes' law"; provides that a person is guilty of murder in the second degree when they recklessly cause the death of a person less than eighteen years old; relates to sentences of imprisonment for felonies for causing the death of a person less than eighteen years old.

descrip: Relates to the disclosure of artificial intelligence use in floor statements and debate by members of the legislature
summary: Enacts the "compulsory artificial narrative disclosure for official rhetoric (CANDOR) act" in relation to requiring any member of the senate or assembly that rises to speak, read a statement, or enter comments into the official legislative record to verbally state a standard disclosure prior to delivering such remarks if such remarks were drafted in whole or in part by artificial intelligence or generative artificial intelligence.

descrip: Enacts Firefighter Joseph P. Spor Jr.'s Law requiring the establishment of September eleventh awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts
summary: Enacts Firefighter Joseph P. Spor Jr.'s Law; requires the commissioner of education to establish September eleventh awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts; requires the education department to make curriculum materials and other resources regarding September eleventh available on its website.

descrip: Increases the penalties for overtaking and passing a school bus
summary: Increases the penalties for overtaking and passing a school bus; provides that for the first conviction a person shall be punished by a fine of not less than $350 nor more than $500; provides that for a second conviction a person shall be punished by a fine of not less than $500 nor more than $800; also provides that for a third conviction a person shall be punished by a fine of not less than $800 nor more than $1500.

descrip: Relates to deadline for the processing of building permits by local governments and the city of New York
summary: Requires local building departments to process and approve or deny applications for residential or mixed-use buildings within 30 days; provides that if the local department does not process the application within the required timeframe an applicant shall be permitted to retain a private professional to perform the permit review to determine compliance with state and/or local building codes.

descrip: Relates to the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child
summary: Includes the act of, when knowing the character and content thereof, a person produces, directs or promotes any obscene synthetic sexual performance, as committing the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child; defines "obscene synthetic sexual performance".

descrip: Relates to enacting the "vehicle streaming device ban" act
summary: Bans the sale of certain devices which allow video streaming on the center console or infotainment center of a motor vehicle which are in view of the driver, and the use of such devices while a vehicle is in motion.

descrip: Relates to health care for children; repealer
summary: Removes the household income as a factor for determining eligibility for healthcare for children.

descrip: Relates to establishing distinctive "In God We Trust" license plates
summary: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to issue "In God We Trust" license plates.

descrip: Regulates the sale and marketing of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles
summary: Regulates the sale of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles; requires sellers of E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles to post a certain notice; prohibits deceptive marketing practices with regard to E-motos and electric off-highway motorcycles.

descrip: Enacts the technical evaluation, risk monitoring, incident notification, AI testing, oversight, and response act or the TERMINATOR Act
summary: Relates to independent safety evaluations, monitoring, reporting, security, mitigation, employee protections and enforcement relating to frontier artificial intelligence models.

descrip: Creates a true cost of economic security study
summary: Creates a true cost of economic security study to measure how much income and other resources are needed for a family of a given composition in a given geographic location to adequately meet a comprehensive set of regular household costs, set aside savings both for future planning and for short-term emergencies, and manage debt.

descrip: Establishes the crime of private carrier package theft
summary: Establishes the crime of private carrier package theft; designates private carrier package theft a class E felony punishable by a fine of not more than two hundred fifty thousand dollars.

descrip: Makes all state lands subject to taxation for all purposes
summary: Makes all state lands subject to taxation for all purposes.

descrip: Authorizes the taxation of state land in the county of Westchester
summary: Authorizes the taxation of state land in the county of Westchester.

descrip: Relates to judicial diversion programs; repealer
summary: Relates to judicial diversion programs; establishes a diversion part in each county; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

descrip: Relates to banning shock gloves
summary: Prohibits any person, firm, corporation, association or agent or employee thereof from importing, manufacturing, selling, holding for sale or distributing shock gloves; makes possession of shock gloves a misdemeanor.

descrip: Prohibits nondisclosure agreements intended to conceal information about the development of a data center from the public or intended to prevent public review thereof
summary: Prohibits municipal corporations from entering into a contract or other agreement that has the purpose or effect of concealing the details of the development of a data center from the public or preventing public review of a data center; prohibits data centers from entering into a contract or other agreement having such purpose; exempts agreements solely intended to protect trade secrets.

descrip: Enacts the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act"
summary: Enacts the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from knowingly providing material support or resources to designated foreign terrorist organizations; allows for recovery of a civil penalty by the state attorney general; creates a private right of action for violations.

descrip: Establishes the New York flight grant program
summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to establish the New York flight grant program to offer grants to municipalities, government organizations, or community not-for-profit organizations to apply for grants to use in negotiations with airlines to attract new, direct flights and service to airports in this state; appropriates $15,000,000 therefor.

descrip: Requires certain physicians or other authorized practitioners to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome
summary: Requires every physician or other authorized practitioner attending pregnant persons in this state to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome as part of routine prenatal care.

descrip: Allows certain persons to practice as a mental health practitioner under supervision for a certain period of time if application and fee requirements are met
summary: Provides that a person with a master's level degree required for practicing as a mental health practitioner shall be allowed to practice under supervision for a period of up to ninety days after the submission of the required application and fees.

descrip: Authorizes the division of housing and community renewal to enforce building codes
summary: Authorizes the division of housing and community renewal to enforce building codes for properties owned by local municipalities and housing authorities.
